verdict.rationale: Logseq's own docs confirm Android and iOS apps exist and that Logseq Sync syncs whole graphs to them (up to 10), which suggests the full knowledge base is available on mobile. No evidence shows that capture, search, linking, queries or plugins work on mobile at desktop parity, and the documented quick-capture protocol is aimed at browsers and the command line. missing for 10: documented mobile feature parity (search, page/block linking, queries on iOS/Android), mobile-specific capture features, and independent hands-on reports of the mobile apps.
